facts.source: WordNet 3.1 noun hypernym facts derived from the Round 025 corpus
facts.storage: typed hyperedges in an append-only arena outside the root; concept-anchored pair posting lists
facts.collision_policy: explicit source/relation comparison after pair lookup

retrieval.relative_speed: conventional hash index about 4.3x faster in this microbenchmark

non_claims: This is not a trained retrieval-augmented language decoder.
It does not test unseen-word inference; the 2,000 two-hop queries are sampled from already stored links.
The pair-index posting lists are headed in a separate fixed index array, not embedded directly in the root record.
The conventional hash index is faster in this microbenchmark; no unique mirror-geometry performance advantage is established.
The long-context test retrieves existing facts after distractors; it does not test neural generation.
The root float lanes receive a demonstrative triangle update, not next-token training.
There is no concurrent writer, WAL, or persistent hyperedge snapshot in this round.
No GPU, quantum, canonical merge, or live deployment claim is made.

integration.next_gate: connect Round 031 native decoder to retrieval states and compare against a matched conventional memory baseline
